"The Trump administration violated federal law by withholding tens of millions of dollars in research grant funding Congress had appropriated for the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)...

"The AHRQ is a relatively small federal agency dedicated to making healthcare safer, more affordable and more effective and is estimated to have funded research that’s saved thousands of lives and billions of dollars over the past 27 years.

Statement on Trump Suspending Microsoft from the PERM Program:

This is a crucial issue for me as the top Democrat on the Immigration Subcommittee, the only member of Congress to have actually had an H-1B visa, and the Representative for tens of thousands of Microsoft workers. The administration has been consistently working to take away legal pathways for immigrants to contribute their talents to our country, and this is yet another of those attacks.

The PERM program is the first step toward an employment-based green card for countless workers who want to contribute to this country, and it lays out a clear process with steps to ensure that this is a net benefit to our economy and does not harm American jobs. Our economy, our communities, and our families depend on immigrants in many sectors, including the tech sector, and heavy-handed attacks like this only hurt efforts to build a strong, stable, and diverse base of workers who have legal pathways to come and be in the United States while also protecting U.S. workers from unscrupulous employers.

You don’t fix a broken immigration system by taking a hammer to legal immigration. Microsoft has been a leader in advocating for comprehensive immigration reforms that modernize an antiquated immigration system and provide more — not fewer — legal pathways for immigrants from all over the world to work here and be with their families. Targeting Microsoft or the PERM program in this way simply undermines legal immigration and weakens America’s ability to innovate.

I could not be happier to welcome the Marines and Sailors of the USS Abraham Lincoln home to San Diego today after an extraordinarily long, demanding, and difficult deployment.
 
These heroes have done everything their country asked of them and more, and they have earned this homecoming. But their return cannot be the end of this story. 
 
What happened aboard the Lincoln cannot ever be allowed to happen again.
 
This Administration owes these families answers: answers to conditions aboard the ship and what will be done differently going forward. 
 
For months, Marines and Sailors sounded the alarm about conditions aboard the ship, inadequate support, and the mental health toll this deployment was taking on those serving onboard. Their families begged for help and were repeatedly ignored.
 
And when those families were forced to turn to the press just to be heard, Pete Hegseth responded by telling the world the reports were fake news.
 
That is beyond unacceptable. It's a betrayal of the men and women who put everything on the line for this country. 
 
Secretary Hegseth now wants to suggest that holding him accountable somehow diminishes the service of the Lincoln’s crew.
 
The opposite is true. Honoring them means telling the truth about what they went through. It means finding out why their warnings were ignored, who failed them, and what is going to change before another crew is put through the same thing.
 
I need firm assurances from this Administration that the crews now carrying out these and future missions will never be subjected to the same failures.
 
Our Marines and Sailors upheld their duty to this country, and the people entrusted with leading them must be held to theirs.

Did you hear about how Trump has started mailing out so-called ACA Refund Checks? After driving up health care costs, this is a slap in the face to all of us. And the timing… well the timing speaks for itself.

Here’s what you need to know:

First, Trump and his Rubber Stamp Republicans in Washington let ACA tax credits expire last year, driving up health care costs for millions of Americans. Health care premiums jumped by over $700 per year, per person, with families often seeing annual premium increases in the thousands.

As a result, over 2 million people have lost ACA coverage, unable to afford higher prices. In Ohio, we had the largest coverage drop, by percentage, in the country, with over 100,000 people losing coverage.

What’s worse? House Democrats forced a vote to extend these credits, which passed, but the President blocked the extension.

Now, just weeks before an election, Trump is mailing out $500 checks with a propaganda letter littered with lies. He claims these are rebates from excess fees.

But everyone is receiving the same “rebate” amount. How did they pick who got rebates? Well according to Reuters, 71% of these checks are going to just 13 states, and most of them are now states with the most competitive races, including Ohio.

Here’s the kicker: while more than 2 million Americans have lost their ACA plans and more than 20 million Americans have been enrolled in ACA plans in the past, Trump is mailing these checks to just a small number of people – less than one million.

None of this adds up. Instead of lowering premiums, restoring affordable coverage, or helping families get back on a plan they can afford, Trump is sending out checks that don’t begin to cover the costs he’s helped create.

In other words, it’s a failed PR stunt … one that is more than a day late and a dollar short.

Today marks another year since the horrific terrorist attacks of October 7, 2023, a day of unimaginable loss that forever changed the lives of so many families in Israel and around the world.

A month and a half ago, I traveled to Israel, and had the profound opportunity to sit down with survivors and hear their stories firsthand. I listened as they shared what they endured, the loved ones they lost, and how they have found the strength to say they want peace.

Their stories have stayed with me.

I made this documentary because these voices deserve to be heard and remembered. At a moment when the pain of October 7 can too easily become reduced to headlines, arguments, and statistics, I wanted people to hear directly from those who lived through it, to see their humanity, their grief, and their resilience.

On this anniversary, I am remembering the lives that were taken, standing with the survivors and families who continue to carry this trauma, and recommitting myself to the work of combating terrorism, antisemitism and pursuing a future where Israelis and Palestinians can live with safety, dignity, and lasting peace.

I hope you’ll take a few minutes to watch and hear their stories.

Today marks three years since Hamas targeted Israeli civilians in the horrific October 7th attacks.

As we remember the more than 1,200 lives lost and the countless lives changed forever that day, we must commit to fighting antisemitism and hatred in all its forms and continue working toward lasting peace in the Middle East.

As we mark the third anniversary of the October 7th Hamas terrorist attack, we mark the return of every hostage, honor their families’ tireless advocacy, recognize those who did not return, and remember all of the lives lost. We must continue to strive for stability and peace in the region for Israelis and Palestinians.

Over the past week, I have been rewatching gut-wrenching videos taken by Hamas terrorists of their own massacre of Israeli families, grandparents and children three years ago today, reading about new accounts of hostages in brutal captivity, and thinking back to my own experience taking my young children back and forth to a bomb shelter as rockets rained down from Gaza. I think often about how the Iron Dome may very well have saved my family’s lives that day, along with thousands of other innocent civilians in Israel. 

Since 2007 when Israel withdrew from Gaza and turned control over to Hamas, neither Israel nor Gazan civilians have been in charge. Instead, it has been governed by a globally-designated terrorist group whose stated mission and sole focus is to wipe out Israel, which they tried to do three years ago and then carried on for years by holding hundreds of Israeli hostages in brutal conditions in their terror tunnel network. That terrorist group remains armed and dangerous in Gaza today, still fully committed to wiping out Israel, the world’s only safe haven for Jews and the only democracy in the region. 

If you are someone — like me — who wants peace in the region and self-determination for all people there, then Hamas represents a complete and total obstacle to that goal. As we remember the devastation inflicted by them on this day three years ago, we must also recognize that Iranian-backed terrorist groups such as Hamas remain an existential threat not only to peace in the region but also to democracy around the world. 

Today is a day of mourning and remembrance of all those innocent lives lost, those who were wounded both physically and mentally, the hostages who survived through unspeakable conditions, and a country shaken to its core by the genocidal attack three years ago. Tomorrow, I will continue working towards a path to peace, security and self-determination for Israelis and Palestinians alike.

Am Yisrael Chai.

Mi oficina está al tanto de los reportes sobre operativos federales de inmigración en Fresno y los condados circundantes, y estamos monitoreando de cerca la situación. He estado en contacto con funcionarios locales y federales, así como con organizaciones comunitarias, mientras trabajamos para obtener más información sobre estos reportes.

Mi prioridad es asegurar que nuestras comunidades tengan información precisa y que se protejan los derechos y la seguridad de los residentes del Valle Central. Compartiremos información adicional a medida que sepamos más.

A quienes están tan preocupados como yo, les pido que se mantengan atentos y nos ayuden a entender lo que está ocurriendo en nuestro Valle. Si presencian un operativo de inmigración en su comunidad o lugar de trabajo, o creen que durante un operativo se pudieron haber violado los derechos de alguna persona, comuníquense con mi oficina y cuéntennos lo que presenciaron. Documentar estos incidentes nos ayuda a entender lo que está sucediendo y determinar qué medidas adicionales pueden ser necesarias.

Se han planteado serias dudas sobre si las autoridades federales de inmigración están actuando de conformidad con la ley, además de incidentes que han resultado en lesiones graves y muertes, incluso de ciudadanos estadounidenses. Las autoridades federales de inmigración deben cumplir con la ley y respetar los derechos constitucionales y la seguridad de todas las personas.

En este momento, les pido a todos que conozcan sus derechos al interactuar con las autoridades federales de inmigración. Les invitamos a consultar estos recursos y compartirlos con sus familiares, amigos y miembros de la comunidad.

My office is aware of reports of federal immigration enforcement activity in Fresno and surrounding counties and is closely monitoring the situation. I have been in contact with local and federal officials and key advocates as we work to gather more information about these troubling reports.

My priority is making sure our communities have accurate information and that the rights and safety of Central Valley residents are protected. We will share additional information as we learn more.

For those who are as concerned as I am, I encourage you to stay engaged and help us understand what is happening in our Valley. If you witness immigration enforcement activity in your community or workplace, or believe an enforcement action may have violated someone’s rights, please contact my office and let us know what you witnessed. Documenting these incidents helps us understand what is happening on the ground and determine where further action may be necessary.

We have seen serious questions raised about whether federal immigration enforcement actions are complying with the law, as well as incidents resulting in serious injuries and deaths, including those involving U.S. citizens. Federal immigration authorities must follow the law and respect the constitutional rights and safety of every person.

At this time, I encourage everyone to know their rights if interacting with federal immigration authorities. Please review and share the resources below with your family and community.
